title: Smart Money Instrument Concentration and Leave-One-Instrument-Out Audit
interpretation: Pooled performance is highly instrument-composition sensitive: removing only 제주반도체 flips the pooled average from negative to positive, while removing HPSP worsens it to about -2.46%.
This is diagnostic association, not evidence that 제주반도체 should be excluded or HPSP/SK하이닉스 should be selected. Such exclusion after seeing outcomes would be post-selection bias.
Instrument heterogeneity must be tested prospectively or in purged chronological OOS before any universe filter or state-specific probability is promoted.
contamination_limitations: Events overlap in 5-trading-day forward windows; effective independent n is UNKNOWN.
Universe is only the repository watchlist and is not a PIT broad-market universe.
Instrument selection/exclusion based on these results would create look-ahead/post-selection bias.
No clustered confidence interval is available because exact session/overlap cluster IDs are not persisted.
